facts.text: Under the Western Undergraduate Exchange, eligible nonresident students from member states and territories can enroll at Boise State at 150 percent of resident tuition.

sources.title: Western Undergraduate Exchange (WUE) - Admissions
sources.quote: WUE (pronounced “woo-ee”) is the Western Undergraduate Exchange, a tuition reciprocity agreement that enables students from member states and territories to enroll in participating two- and four-year public institutions at 150 percent of the university's resident tuition.
